report.scene_summary: The video shows a manufacturing floor with large industrial machinery, including a blue mechanical power press, and marked pedestrian aisles. A worker is observed operating the blue press, while other workers are seen walking in the background. The scene contains various stored materials and equipment adjacent to the marked walkways.

findings.title: Obstruction of marked aisle by stored material
findings.location: Aisles adjacent to the blue press and along the right-hand wall
findings.observation: A large metal coil is stored on the floor in Zone Z06, crossing the yellow painted aisle boundary. In Zone Z08, a rack of materials and a white container are stored along the wall, with the white container crossing the green painted aisle boundary. These objects encroach on the marked pedestrian routes.
findings.risk_interpretation: Stored materials obstructing marked aisles create a tripping hazard and restrict the clear width of the walkway, violating requirements for safe clearances and unobstructed passageways.
findings.applicability_reason: The stored objects (coil, rack, container) are stationary items placed within the marked pedestrian aisles, physically reducing the available path width.
recommended_actions: Relocate the metal coil and the white container to a designated storage area outside the marked aisle boundaries.
Ensure all stored materials maintain the required clearance from marked pedestrian routes.

findings.title: Worker proximity to mechanical power press
findings.observation: A worker is positioned at the control station of the blue mechanical power press. The worker is observed reaching towards the machine's point of operation area. The machine's operational state (running vs. stopped) and the status of the point-of-operation guarding (whether it is active and effective) are not definitively verifiable from the still frames.
findings.risk_interpretation: If the machine is operating or has residual energy, reaching into the point of operation without proper safeguarding presents a severe crushing or amputation hazard.
findings.applicability_reason: The machine is a mechanical power press. The worker's position and activity near the point of operation require verification of safeguarding and energy control.
recommended_actions: Verify the machine is stopped and energy-isolated (LOTO) before any worker enters the danger zone.
Confirm the point-of-operation guard is in place and functioning correctly.
Ensure the worker is using appropriate PPE (e.g., eye protection) if exposed to hazards.

zone_reviews.interpretation: Worker operating a blue mechanical power press.
Worker walking along the marked aisle.
Aisle leading to the 'MAMUL DEPO' area.
White mechanical press with yellow guarding.
Large metal coil stored on the floor, crossing the yellow aisle line.
Area between the blue press and the white press.
Materials stored along the wall, with a white container crossing the green aisle line.
Floor area near the blue press with cables.

dismissed.reason: The worker's face is not clearly visible in the provided frames, making it impossible to confirm the presence or absence of eye protection. This uncertainty prevents a definitive PPE violation claim.
As a still image review, it is not possible to determine if the machine is actively running or if the worker is performing a setup/maintenance task. The hazard claim is dependent on this unknown.

limitations: No reliable floor-like mask found; static-zone ranking uses general scene candidates.
Machine operational state and energy control status are unknown.
